qualification: Passed exact source curves, independent Blender motion/physical witnesses, all native runtime poses/transitions, actual gameplay full-cycle renderer and original secondary-effect gates
method: Remove only redundant bit-identical constant-run animation key interiors. Original geometry, normal, UV, image, material, skin, rest/bind and every corrective target stay unchanged.

animation_accessor_storage.scope: Unique referenced source animation accessor logical bytes; shared buffer views may overlap. Not a process RSS claim.

corrective_graphics_buffer_bytes.scope: Raw imported Godot blend_shape_data byte count in the common runtime mesh surface format.

baseline.scope: Independent fresh Blender import geometry/motion witness check. Blender is not the authority for runtime morph normal shading.

candidate.scope: Independent fresh Blender import geometry/motion witness check. Blender is not the authority for runtime morph normal shading.

runtime.scope: Actual imported Godot mesh arrays, native-library sampled poses and crossfades or mounted gait samples, renderer activation cutoff, linear blended skin; image rendering remains a separate check.

rig_investigation.decision: Retain original skin and all correctives. Triangle fragments passing individual tests are part of one connected welded body; extracting them would divide coincident seams. No seam guard was relaxed.

visual.review: Normal, GroundPound and effect contact boards reviewed visually. All eight full-cycle paired GIFs retained locally; tiny raster-edge differences.
